spec.sequence: Coming west through the trees from the hiring camp, the rock bank shows first, then the root mass against it, then the dark mouth between them.
spec.wayfinding: No path reaches it. The bank is the one patch of grey rock among the trees.

spec.value: A void opened where the root layer lifted the ground deep in the jungle. Something moved into it.
An occupant that has made a lair of it and dragged in what it has taken.
The evicted families at the hiring camp a kilometre east no longer forage this way. Any of them will tell a stranger why, at length.
A dry void under the root layer, root-walled and rock-floored, with one defensible mouth.
If it were cleared, the hiring camp's foraging range would double.

value.why: One mouth, its rock bank and the scatter in front of it; the lair itself is the cell below.

spec.orientationWhy: Its mouth faces east, toward the hiring camp, home of the lost foragers.

playerPurpose.note: Everything the occupant has taken, piled deep in the hollow.
One thing in the den worth the fight.
